The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (November 4, 2021) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Tender, Ariba Document Number 3092490224 Description: The Project involves the supply and installation of heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) system replacement, electrical upgrades and washroom renovation at Yonge Collection Yard. Recommended Supplier: LCD Mechanical Inc. Contract Award Value: $1,415,729 net of all applicable taxes and charges $1,599,774 including HST and all applicable charges $1,440,646 net Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries Contract is expected to start from date of the written order to commence work for a period of eighty-four (84) working days.
